title: perf(app-shell): a packaged app's object route asks its lookup targets without views
body:
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb99UApg2HDL6vC7wFG5UA5v)_ Fixes #29551 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none Claim: 6586992712 ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:有包的应用里,对象页读取本对象查找字段的目标对象(例如 `owner` 指向的 `sys_user`)时,改为按名读取且不带视图,与无包应用的做法一致。本对象、`requiresObject` 和导航对象仍然带视图。 - 为什么改:目标对象不在应用包(bundle)里时,带视图的读法会为它下载整张 `/meta/view` 列表(app-crm 上 7,014 B),而查找字段只需要目标对象的定义。 - 风险与回滚:查找目标的定义照旧按名到达并并入对象作用域,查找单元格的链接与名称不变;目标对象不再带视图,实测路由上没有读取查找目标视图的地方。回滚方法是 revert 本 PR。注意:在 #29550 落地前,`ObjectView` 的已存视图读取仍会请求同一张 `/meta/view`,所以 app-crm 上线路字节暂时不变;两者都落地后该列表消失(本地探针已实测)。 - 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appObjectScope.ts` 的 `readObjectRouteNames` 末尾(有包分支的查找目标读取),然后是 `appObjectScope-12811` 测试末尾新增的两个用例。 - 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/appObjectScope-12811.test.tsx`,预期 6 个用例全部通过。 - 需要你做的:无,席位落地。 ## What changes In an app whose served item names its package, an object route reads the route object's lookup targets through `readObjectRouteNames`. On the packaged branch it asked them with the route's names through the package scope's with-views read (`read([...names, ...lookups])`). A target outside the app bundle, such as `sys_user` behind `crm_account.owner`, then composed its views from the whole `/meta/view` list. | | Before | Now | |---|---|---| | Packaged app, lookup targets | `readObjectScope({ packageId, names: [...names, ...lookups] })`, with views, returned as the route's scope | `readObjectScope({ packageId, names: lookups, views: false })`; the scope returned is the route's names read, which the targets join as they land (the same package scope entry) | | Package-less app, lookup targets | `{ names: lookups, views: false }` | unchanged | | Route object, `requiresObject` entries, palette nav objects | with views | unchanged, with views | Readers of the lookup targets' views on a packaged object route, checked before the edit: none. A lookup cell links and names its target. `ObjectView`'s saved-views read, `useServedViewItems` and `RecordFormPage` read the route object's views only. A record drawer or form overlay reads the whole registry beside or instead of the scope, as before. `ready` and the route's failure outcome still come from the route object's read alone. ## Tests - `appObjectScope-12811`, two new cases with a ready app bundle that holds `crm_account` and `crm_contact` with their views: - `/apps/crm/crm_account` (lookup `owner` to `sys_user`, outside the bundle): the reads are `object?package=app.crm` and `object/sys_user`, and no `view` list. The scope reads `crm_account[crm_account.all]`, `crm_contact[crm_contact.all]`, `sys_user[]`. - CONTROL `/apps/crm/crm_contact` (lookup to `crm_account`, in the bundle): only `object?package=app.crm`, and the same composed views as before. - Ablation: restoring `return { scope: read([...names, ...lookups]), ... }` on the packaged branch turns the first case red on the extra `view` read; the CONTROL stays green. - `AppContent.objectScope-12811`, `AppContent.packagelessReads-29416` and the `openPathObjectReaders-12811` census need no change and are green. ## Acceptance notes - The bytes on the wire do not drop yet. With this reader gone, the same `/meta/view` list (7,014 B) is now first asked by `ObjectView`'s saved-views read (`dataSource.listViews` to the adapter's `readViewList`), which #29550 is removing. Before this change that read shared the request this reader started. A local probe with that read stubbed showed no `/meta/view` request at all on both routes. - Request counts differ by preference and `security/explain` writes only; the `meta` and `data` reads are the same set. ## Verification
Production Console, app-crm (objectstack dev --fresh --seed-admin), base dbca3ef0 and fix cb81f443 Playwright signs in, opens each route, reloads with the cache disabled, and logs every `/api/` request with its CDP initiator stack (async depth 64). The `crm_app` bundle holds the CRM objects; `crm_account` and `crm_contact` look up `sys_user`, `sys_organization` and `sys_business_unit`, which it does not hold. `/apps/crm_app/crm_account`, en: - Before: 30 requests, 1,033,677 B. `GET /api/v1/meta/view` (7,014 B), initiator the packaged lookup read in `readObjectRouteNames`, called from `useAppObjectScopePrefetch`. - After: 28 requests, 1,033,049 B. `GET /api/v1/meta/view` (7,014 B), initiator `ObjectView`'s `listViews` to `readViewList`; nothing from `appObjectScope`. - Probe, after plus `ObjectView`'s `listViews` stubbed (not committed): 28 requests, 1,027,054 B, no `/meta/view`. `/apps/crm_app/crm_contact`, en: - Before: 28 requests, 1,034,072 B, `/meta/view` from the same packaged lookup read. - After: 28 requests, 1,034,072 B, `/meta/view` from `ObjectView`'s `listViews` only. - Probe: 27 requests, 1,027,058 B, no `/meta/view`. Both routes read `meta/object/sys_organization`, `sys_user` and `sys_business_unit` by name before and after.
Local runs - Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty): 1 failed, 5 passed. - Sweep at `cb81f443` under `os-verify-lock`, `--maxWorkers=2`: 139 test files naming the scope readers or `AppContent`, 1,092 tests, all passed. - `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`: 65/65 at `cb81f443` and at `fadf5b2f` (merge of main). - `eslint` on the changed files: 0 errors. - Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`) at `cb81f443`: 34 commands, all exit 0, reconciled with `--ran` (34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED). - At `fadf5b2f`: the four scope test files (23 tests) pass; `check-sdui-manifest`, `check-changeset-no-major` and spec `check:generated` exit 0.
